POM “Armhole (front + back)” names a source edge that is not drawn on this face; its value remains table-only.
POM “Sleeve length (cap–hem)” names a source edge that is not drawn on this face; its value remains table-only.
POM “Back side-vent depth” has a back-face anchor and remains table-only on the front view.
POM “Back body length (HPS–hem)” has a back-face anchor and remains table-only on the front view.
POM “Back hem drop” has a back-face anchor and remains table-only on the front view.
